name: TEMPLATE — Kühtai west ramp (L237, Ochsengarten → Kühtai)
description: Placeholder seed for a first test ride. 18 hazards along the 6.8 km climb from Ochsengarten (west) up to Kühtai, placed on the real road centre line from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Headings point uphill (eastbound) unless the note says westbound; one hazard is omnidirectional (heading null). Replace this file with your own: copy it to Files › On My iPhone › Hazard POC › seed_hazards.json. Fields: lat, lon, heading (0-359 or null), category (gravel|cattle|accident|surface|other), optional headingTolerance, createdAt, expiresAt, note. Without createdAt a hazard is treated as created when the app loads it, so it never expires between launches — except accident, which expires 3 hours after load by design.
